# appgatesdp_administrative_role (Resource)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24, v25.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the object.
- `privileges` (Attributes List) Administrative privilege list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--privileges))

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID of the object.
- `notes` (String) Notes for the object. Used for documentation purposes.
- `tags` (List of String) Array of tags.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Create date.
- `read_only` (Boolean) Whether the entity is protected from manual updates and deletes. Supported in API versions: v24, v25.
- `updated` (String) Last update date.

<a id="nestedatt--privileges"></a>
### Nested Schema for `privileges`

Required:

- `target` (String) The target of the Privilege defines the possible target objects for that type.
- `type` (String) The type of the Privilege defines the possible administrator actions.

Optional:

- `default_tags` (List of String) The items in this list would be added automatically to the newly created objects' tags. Only applicable on "Create" type and targets with tagging capability. This field must be omitted if not applicable.
- `functions` (List of String) Privilege for changing Appliance Functions. Only applicable on "AssignFunction" type with Appliance or All target. This field must be omitted if not applicable.
- `scope` (Attributes) The scope of the Privilege. Only applicable to certain type-target combinations. Some types depend on the IdP/MFA type, such as GetUserAttributes. This field must be omitted if not applicable. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--privileges--scope))

<a id="nestedatt--privileges--scope"></a>
### Nested Schema for `privileges.scope`

Optional:

- `all` (Boolean) 'If "true", all objects are accessible. For example, "type: Edit - target: Condition - scope.all: true" means the administrator can edit all Conditions in the system.'
- `ids` (List of String) Specific object IDs this Privilege would have access to.
- `tags` (List of String) Object tags this privilege would have access to.
